tasks.title: Clean idle caches
tasks.what: A loop's sandbox cache (tools' caches and past passes' agent folders) when the loop has not run for a while.

tasks.title: Compact databases
tasks.what: Checkpoint, optimise and vacuum the server's database and every loop's record; a record's designs kept once (a running loop's too, a few rows at a time).

tasks.title: Condense run logs
tasks.what: A loop's log over a size keeps its recent part; the older part is gzipped beside it.

tasks.title: Bring task journals up to date
tasks.what: A loop's task journal written before the engine said what each task is (D1233) is rewritten in today's format, once, by the rules Live read it by: each task's box, pass, design and try, how each try ended, the bookkeeping as notes. The original is kept beside it (events.jsonl.orig.gz). A running loop is left until it stops.

tasks.title: Condense task journals
tasks.what: A loop's task journal (the Live tree's history) over a size keeps its recent starts whole; older ones are gzipped beside it.

tasks.title: Thin old transcripts
tasks.what: A loop's transcript (every model and agent turn: its prompt, reply and tool calls) keeps its last days whole; an older turn keeps only what usage counts -- when, who, tokens, cost, whether it failed and why. Insights reads the usage log, summed as turns happen. Running loops too: a turn is appended on its own.

tasks.title: Prune old agent folders
tasks.what: A loop's working folders of passes started more than the days ago (each agent's prompt, drafts and scratch) go -- its newest folder always stays, and the journal, the transcript, the record and the workbench. Running loops too: an old pass's folder is not written to.

tasks.title: Prune stale records
tasks.what: Record rows measured under other inputs (D853): the loop no longer counts them. Reports them; deletes them when told to.

tasks.title: Prune empty starts
tasks.what: Starts that did nothing -- stopped before any search, design, check or measurement began (D987) -- go: their row, and for a loop's latest start its log and journal. Starts already checked are left.

tasks.title: Rerun baseline
tasks.what: The loop's next start measures pass 0 again, once (D1005): otherwise a baseline on record stands while the document's baseline: section is unchanged, whatever else changed.

tasks.title: Invalidate + re-evaluate all
tasks.what: After the checks or measurement scripts change (D988): one run checks and measures every design on record again; the earlier results stay as history, no longer counted. Started on one loop only.

tasks.title: Check database integrity
tasks.what: Read-only SQLite integrity checks on the server database and stopped loops' out/*.db records. Reports problems without repairing or deleting data.

tasks.title: Validate loop documents
tasks.what: Load each stopped loop's selected problem document, including referenced parts. Reports errors without changing files or running tools or agents.
